about: Canonical gen-3 inputs and outputs, merged from the names the heads pass proposed (rules/heads/*.jsonl). Every name in an inputs_missing or a tagged outputs entry maps to exactly one entry below, or to covered or dropped. Apply with: python scripts/rules_catalogue.py gen3-fields. Source: snapshot = already recorded, only the input layout changes; record = already recorded, only a target is added; new = needs new collection. An entry's requires lists entries a rule needing it needs as well.

conventions.text: Anything rules text describes is read as ability tokens carrying e vectors, never as a vocabulary of effect kinds. A floating effect, a dungeon room, a temporary grant and a locked face are lines, read through the same ability-token mechanism as printed lines.
conventions.relations: A link between two objects is an edge: a typed, directed relation between their slots. Each relation type adds a learned vector to the key and another to the value where the two slots meet in attention, with its own vectors in every layer and head, as the gen-3 spec's relation-aware trunk (specs/2026-10-30-ability-effect-model-gen3.md, section 10) specifies. A link is never a flag on one end.
conventions.amounts: An amount is a scalar as raw plus log1p, the input layout's convention, with a thermometer added where the model compares it with damage or toughness.
conventions.closed_lists: A one-hot or multi-hot is kept for closed lists Forge defines: zones, phases, colours, card types, designations, event types, replacement results.
conventions.outputs: Outputs use the existing field types (binary, count, signed delta, categorical, multi-binary) and are supervised only by records that carry them, as a field with no event is absent, not zero. Per-entity fields join the per-entity head; act-slot fields join the verdict head; global fields need a global head beside the created-objects head.

inputs.shape: subtype tokens: one learned embedding per subtype, summed into the card slot through the existing subtype_tokens_for hook; the same embeddings serve chosen creature types
inputs.what: creature, artifact, enchantment, land and planeswalker subtypes: Goblin, Aura, Equipment, Saga, Siege, Forest

inputs.shape: one-hot: front, back, flipped, melded, face down (replacing the face-down flag); the lines of a face that is not up stay as ability tokens flagged inactive (in.line_flags), which is also how a face-down card carries its real face
inputs.source: snapshot; a face-down card's real face is new
inputs.what: which face of a double-faced, flip, meld or face-down card is up

inputs.shape: bit, plus an edge to the copied object when it has a slot
inputs.what: whether an object is a copy, and of what

inputs.shape: edge between every two slots whose names match, and between a slot and a name chosen earlier that it matches; no name embedding, because rules only ever compare names
inputs.what: same-name comparisons: the legend rule, 'named', 'with the same name'

inputs.shape: bit
inputs.what: whether the object is a token

inputs.slot: card and global, rewrite and trigger records
inputs.shape: event type one-hot over the event vocabulary and its amount as a scalar; the subject's last-known state as a card slot of its own, linked to the subject by an edge
inputs.source: snapshot for type and amount; the last-known state is new
inputs.what: what the pending event is (a tap or a zone change, cycled or discarded, how much) and what its subject looked like as it left

inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: which permanent an Aura or Equipment is attached to

inputs.slot: edge card to card or player
inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: which player, planeswalker or battle an attacker attacks

inputs.slot: edge stack object to card or player
inputs.shape: edge, one relation type per target index
inputs.what: what each stack object targets, not only the acting ability

inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: the permanent a triggered or activated ability on the stack came from

inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: soulbond pairing

inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: a battle's protector

inputs.slot: edge card to card; the exiled cards become card slots
inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: the cards exiled with or by a permanent (linked abilities, 'until it leaves', impulse exile)

inputs.slot: edge card to card; components become card slots
inputs.shape: edge
inputs.what: the component cards of a mutated permanent

inputs.shape: a scalar per symbol kind: W, U, B, R, G, C, generic, X, each hybrid pair, Phyrexian per colour, snow
inputs.what: the mana cost symbols, beside the mana value already read

inputs.shape: two scalars, each with a thermometer, as toughness has
inputs.what: printed loyalty and defense, which decide the counters a planeswalker or battle enters with

inputs.shape: multi-hot over Forge's closed designation list: goaded, suspected, monstrous, renowned, saddled, solved, ring-bearer, phased out, bestowed, and the rest; goaded is also an edge to the goading player
inputs.what: designations on a permanent, and phased-out status

inputs.shape: flags on every ability token: active (its face is up, its Class level is reached, its Room door is unlocked), granted temporarily (temporary grants become ability tokens, a bare keyword read through its reminder text, instead of a count and a keyword multi-hot; the flag keeps them apart from printed lines, which gate 2's keyword stripping needs), cast with (the alternative-cost or kicker line a spell was cast with, with a count for multikicker), chosen (the option a modal spell chose)
inputs.what: which lines are in force and how a spell was cast, read on the lines themselves

inputs.shape: scalar
inputs.what: the X a permanent or token was cast or created with, kept after it resolves

inputs.shape: typed by what was chosen: a colour as a multi-hot, a card type as a one-hot, a creature type as a subtype token, a number as a scalar, a player or object as an edge, a card name as in.rel_same_name edges, a mode as the chosen flag on its option's line; stored die results as scalars
inputs.what: choices a permanent or effect remembers: Cavern of Souls's creature type, Gods Willing's colour, a linked ability's chosen word

inputs.shape: mana spent per colour as scalars, as the cost half's mana paid; the zone cast from as a one-hot over the zone list; a bit for mana carrying a rider such as Cavern of Souls's. Optional and alternative costs are line flags (in.line_flags)
inputs.what: what mana paid for a spell and where it was cast from

inputs.shape: per player, scalars beside the three existing this-turn counts: cards drawn, life gained, life lost, damage taken, permanents put into a graveyard, spells cast last turn, dungeons completed, descended; per card, bits: entered this turn, attacked, blocked, activated a loyalty ability; an edge to each source that dealt it damage this turn
inputs.what: what happened earlier in the turn or the game

inputs.shape: scalar rank among the slots of the same zone: timestamp on the battlefield, position on the stack, position in a graveyard or library
inputs.what: timestamps and zone order, which decide layer order, the world rule and stack order

inputs.shape: scalar
inputs.what: a player's speed

inputs.shape: bit
inputs.what: whether a player has the city's blessing

inputs.shape: scalar
inputs.what: rad counters on a player

inputs.shape: bit
inputs.what: who is the monarch

inputs.shape: bit; the Undercity itself is an in.dungeon slot
inputs.what: who has the initiative

inputs.shape: one-hot: day, night, neither
inputs.what: day and night

inputs.slot: card slot in the command zone, linked to its player by an edge
inputs.shape: read like a permanent: its rooms are ability tokens, the current room flagged active (in.line_flags)
inputs.what: the dungeon a player is in and the room they are in

inputs.slot: card slot in the command zone, one per Forge effect object (an Effect card) and per pending delayed trigger
inputs.shape: read like a permanent: its ability tokens are the e vectors of the source lines that created it (the source line, or the sub-ability its traits come from where the sidecar's sub-ability index finds it); structured only for what text cannot say: edges to the objects it affects or remembers, its duration over the three duration values, and the amount left on a shield that counts down
inputs.what: effects from resolved spells that wait or last: prevention and regeneration shields, 'the next time' replacements, delayed triggers, cast permissions, restrictions

inputs.shape: card slots for the top card of each library and every library card the record's events name, with in.order_rank as their position
inputs.what: library cards an effect moves, reveals or looks at, which today have no slot

inputs.shape: scalars: each die result, and the coin flips won and lost
inputs.what: the random results of the resolving ability, taken as given like a decision

outputs.shape: categorical: resolved, fizzled, partially fizzled, countered, declined; the input flag on the acting-ability slot is removed
outputs.what: whether a spell or ability resolved or fizzled

outputs.shape: binary: lost the game. In a two-player game a win is the other player's loss, and a draw is both losing
outputs.what: a player winning or losing the game

outputs.shape: categorical: front, back, flipped, melded, face down; supervised where a face-change event names the card or it enters
outputs.what: the face a card has after a face change, or as it enters

outputs.shape: signed delta per symbol kind against in.mana_cost, like power_delta
outputs.what: how much reductions and increases changed a spell's cost

outputs.shape: multi-binary gained and multi-binary lost over in.designations' list; count of Class levels gained; binary each for a Room door unlocked, paired, protector changed, merged
outputs.what: a permanent gaining or losing a designation, levelling up, unlocking a door, pairing, merging

outputs.shape: count of copies made of a spell, at the copied stack object; binary for a permanent becoming a copy
outputs.what: copies of spells and permanents

outputs.shape: binary each: became the monarch, took the initiative, gained the city's blessing, ventured, completed a dungeon; speed gained as a count
outputs.what: a player's game-level state changing

outputs.shape: categorical: became day, became night, unchanged
outputs.what: day becoming night or night becoming day

outputs.shape: multi-binary gained and multi-binary lost over the subtypes the corpus's effects grant or remove, a closed list build-corpus writes to the manifest; supertypes as a second pair
outputs.what: subtypes and supertypes gained or lost

outputs.shape: count of non-keyword abilities gained; binary for abilities lost; binary for text changed. What was gained is in the acting line's own text, and it reaches the input afterwards as a temporarily granted token
outputs.what: non-keyword abilities gained or lost, and text-changing effects

outputs.shape: signed delta of base power and of base toughness, like power_delta
outputs.what: effects that set base power and toughness, such as Ensoul Artifact or a characteristic-defining ability

outputs.shape: binary each: removed from combat, became blocked, put onto the battlefield attacking or blocking
outputs.what: changes to a creature's place in combat

outputs.shape: binary; the new targets are a decision and reach the input as in.rel_targets
outputs.what: a spell's targets changed or redirected

outputs.shape: count of effect objects and delayed triggers the resolution created; they then appear as in.floating_effects slots
outputs.what: a resolution setting up a delayed trigger or a lasting effect

outputs.shape: counts: extra turns, turns skipped, extra steps or phases, steps or phases skipped
outputs.what: extra and skipped turns, steps and phases

outputs.shape: binary per defender (player, planeswalker, battle) on an attackers record anchored to one attacker, the way a blockers record is anchored to one attacker
outputs.what: which players, planeswalkers and battles each attacker may attack

outputs.shape: binary: must attack, on anchored attackers records; must block the anchored attacker, on blockers records
outputs.what: attack and block requirements, beside the existing permission bits

outputs.shape: categorical over Forge's ReplacementResult
outputs.what: what a replacement or prevention effect did to the event

outputs.shape: count
outputs.what: damage prevented

outputs.shape: binary
outputs.what: a regeneration shield used

outputs.shape: signed delta
outputs.what: energy gained or paid

outputs.shape: signed delta
outputs.what: rad counters gained or lost

extensions.what: zone_outcome gains the values shuffled into library, to command zone, entered the battlefield (apart from blinked) and ceased to exist; library_bottom gets set, and phasing in stops reading as phased_out. Library and exile cards get targets through in.library_cards and in.rel_exiled_with

input: a temporarily granted keyword becomes an ability token read through its reminder text, flagged granted temporarily (in.line_flags), so every Forge keyword reads without a vocabulary. Output: keywords_gained and keywords_lost cover every keyword an effect in the corpus grants or removes, a closed list build-corpus writes to the manifest
a keyword counter (flying, deathtouch ...) reads as a granted keyword token; the other named counters now in 'other' get their own scalar input and signed-delta output

each created group also carries a binary for being controlled by a player other than the actor, its subtypes over out.subtypes_changed's list, its counters per type, and a group kind for emblems, effect objects and cards made outside the game; no name, since a token is read by its characteristics and lines
library_events gains shuffle, and the tutor and surveil bits get set by the events that mean them

planned.what: every line of a permanent as ability slots (snapshot section); also spliced lines, emblems' lines and lines as text-changing effects leave them
active player for every player and card (turn-rule section)
priority holder for every player and card (turn-rule section)
which attacker each blocker blocks (block-pairing section)
timing column of the legality verdict (turn-rule section)
one column per failed rules check (turn-rule section)

fixes.what: build-corpus keeps a permanent spell's resolution record, keyed to the permanent's card, instead of refusing it as acting through no text
turn-based actions (draw, cleanup discard, untap, untap-step phasing and day/night, lore counters, the attack-declaration tap) get a record instead of being discarded
attackers playability records are anchored to one attacker, as blockers records are, and list the defenders that attacker may attack

covered.reason: every rule that lists it also lists the name that fixes it (new:permanent_spell_resolution, or new:created_objects for a token's X counters)

dropped.reason: subgames, restarts and control of another player, which the design leaves out
outside a two-player game without a sideboard, or Un-set and casual mechanics: Attractions, stickers, tickets, companions, sideboards, concession, the opening hand

engine procedure in the middle of an action, two rules or fewer: an activation or payment in progress, a turn ending, the order of pending extra turns, effect expiry, mana emptying, event and stack order as outputs, triggers ceasing
a characteristic the input already shows, with no change to predict: colour derived from mana cost, prototype and other set characteristics, a colour indicator
random results are given as inputs, not predicted
banding: one keyword from 1990s sets, eight rules of bookkeeping
one or two rules each, not worth a field: X as an output, counters paid as a cost, a choice made on resolution, an attachment no Forge card can illustrate
